summary: Keep Fractal web shell cache writes on protected main instead of storing pull-request-only closure copies.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No application, command or protocol compatibility changes. CI retains the same cache key definitions, restore scope, toolchain and cold-shell fallback.

downtime.detail: No service restart or deployment change.

manual.detail: Only protected-main upkeep publishes the shared web shell closure. Pull requests still restore main's matching entry; changed flake inputs or cache misses evaluate the shell cold without saving a pull-request-scoped copy.

recovery.detail: A cache miss still falls back to nix develop .#web. This change deletes no existing cache entries and changes no trust or restore rules.
